topics.name: Process Supervision
topics.purpose: Define supervised start, stop, restart, crash detection and bounded restart policy for exact service instances.

semantics.service_rule: Supervisor manages exact logical service/runtime identity.
semantics.loop_rule: Crash loops are bounded and surfaced.
semantics.stop_rule: Requested stop remains distinct from crash.
semantics.authority_rule: Supervisor lifecycle actions require exact operational authority.
semantics.safety_rule: Supervisor cannot silently weaken service security/config to make startup succeed.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
